4 اخارهُ , (S, K,) inf. n. إِخَارَةٌ, (S,) [app., in its' primary acceptation, He caused him to utter a cry. (See 10.) ―
-b2- And hence,] (assumed tropical:) He bent, turned, or inclined, him, or it. (S, K.) You say, أَخَرْنَا المَطَايَا إِلَى مَوْضِعِ كَذَا (assumed tropical:) We bent, or turned, the riding-camels to such a place. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
